data.narrative:
Pickle Robot Company is a Series B robotics and manufacturing startup seeking valuation after raising $97M to date. The relevant comp universe comprises four same-sector peers at Series B and C stages (Bedrock Robotics at $1.8B, Dexterity at $1.6B, Hadrian at $1.6B, and Nimble Robotics at $1.0B), supplemented by a broader landscape of 9 private robotics firms and 1 public comparable.

Two triangulation methods apply. The stage-progression method applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B progression to the $97M capital raised proxy, yielding $184M. The peer-median method benchmarks against the four same-sector comparables, producing a $1.6B implied valuation (range: $1.0B to $1.8B). These methods reflect different analytical anchors: one grounded in capital history and advancement stage, the other in recent market pricing of direct competitors.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $157M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $905M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around whether Pickle Robot commands pricing closer to earlier-stage capital metrics or closer to late-stage peer valuations. Key uncertainties include the company's relative market position within the peer set, revenue run-rate relative to comparables, and the applicability of the stage-progression multiplier given sector-specific capital intensity.
